```sql
DECLARE @original_phone NVARCHAR(50) = '+1-555-0000042';
DECLARE @customer_id INT = 42;

-- Create a table to hold results for each object checked
CREATE TABLE #results (
    object_name NVARCHAR(255),
    rows_found INT
);

-- Check dbo.customer for the phone number (column has been dropped, so no phone data can exist)
-- We still check the table for any rows where the customer_id matches and any column might contain the phone
INSERT INTO #results (object_name, rows_found)
SELECT 
    'dbo.customer',
    SUM(CASE 
            WHEN full_name = @original_phone OR email = @original_phone THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END)
FROM dbo.customer
WHERE customer_id = @customer_id;

-- Check all user tables and columns for the phone number (excluding the dropped column)
-- This covers any other table that might still contain the phone number
INSERT INTO #results (object_name, rows_found)
SELECT 
    QUOTENAME(s.name) + '.' + QUOTENAME(t.name),
    COUNT(*)
FROM sys.tables t
JOIN sys.schemas s ON t.schema_id = s.schema_id
